$comment: Value-type registry. ESPD-EDM/codelists/ResponseDataType.gc is authoritative for which codes exist, their status and description; this file adds the JSON instanceShape and the request/response UBL value bindings. One entry per ValueDataTypeCode. Leaf VALUE elements and value-bearing attributes (currencyID, unitCode) live here; fixed codelist attributes live in the codelist-attribute profile; kind->element scaffold lives in the encoding profile.

LOT_IDENTIFIER.sourceDescription: Code used to detect an identifier that refers to a Lot

QUANTITY_YEAR.$note: Used both as a buyer REQUIREMENT (count of fiscal years, e.g. C31 — cbc:ExpectedValueNumeric) and as an EO QUESTION answer (e.g. C50 'Year' — cbc:ResponseQuantity with unitCode=YEAR). Both bindings are registered; the compiler picks the side by leaf kind.
QUANTITY_YEAR.sourceDescription: A non-negative integer representing a year. The unit has to be specified as YEAR

QUANTITY_INTEGER.sourceDescription: A number representing a quantity in a specific unit of measure. The unit has to be specified (e.g. Kg).

MINIMUM_QUANTITY_YEAR.$note: Buyer-only REQUIREMENT (minimum number of years). cbc:ExpectedValueNumeric per the BASE request document (no dedicated Expected* element exists for the MINIMUM_QUANTITY_* family).

CODE_BOOLEAN.$note: Buyer REQUIREMENT selecting a GUI control type (CHECK_BOX_TRUE, RADIO_BUTTON_TRUE, ...). Request-only; carries the boolean-gui-control-type codelist attributes.
CODE_BOOLEAN.sourceDescription: Code identifying a type of GUI control element.

CODE.$note: A generic code requirement whose codelist VARIES by use (financial-ratio-type in C34, occupation in C25, eo-role-type in OT59) — the XSLT branches on a per-property codelist name. So the codelist is NOT intrinsic to the value type: it is declared PER LEAF in the sidecar component entry (`codelist`), attached by the overlay, and the generators read it from the leaf. `codeList` on instanceShape is likewise filled per leaf from the sidecar.
CODE.sourceDescription: A code for an unespecified concept

QUANTITY.$note: A generic quantity with no unit (e.g. a financial ratio value). cbc:ResponseQuantity with NO unitCode.
QUANTITY.sourceDescription: A number representing a generic quantity with no unit specified.

MINIMUM_QUANTITY.$note: Buyer REQUIREMENT: a minimum ratio. cbc:ExpectedValueNumeric per the BASE request.

CODE_COUNTRY.$note: First code-valued answer (C07). The response is a cbc:ResponseCode carrying the country code-list attributes; those attributes are the dated 'country' set in the codelist-attribute profile, NOT the 5.0.0 response-data-type set — the per-codelist version the C07 probe exists to prove. instanceShape is a scalar string (an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code); `codeList` marks it so the form derives the codelist.
CODE_COUNTRY.sourceDescription: Code identifying a country (Compulsory use of ISO 3166-1 alpha 2

MINIMUM_AMOUNT.sourceDescription: The minimum amount the answer must have

INDICATOR.sourceDescription: 'true' or 'false' values representing 'Yes' affirmative or 'No' negative answers

PERIOD.sourceDescription: Period object as defined in UBL-2.1

instanceConstraints.$note: A period must carry at least one of start/end date (hand-authored anyOf).

AMOUNT.sourceDescription: An Amount, and currency, as defined in UN/CEFACT's CCTS

ECONOMIC_OPERATOR_IDENTIFIER.sourceDescription: Code used to detect an identifier that refers to an Economic Operator

EVIDENCE_IDENTIFIER.sourceDescription: Points at the instance of an evidence
